title: [finding] dispatch-gates --commands prints `pnpm check:issue-citations` (a --self-test-only script) on stdout with no checker-health marker; 3 devs read it as a diff pass this round and 2 PRs went red in CI
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect with a named landing site**, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (the `--commands` stdout rendering). It is a PM-tooling card, and the fleet cost it caused is measured below. ⛔ Filed bare: routing (`tooling`, `domain:*`) and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution seat (#6024, `session_01UYBdGBzWSrAMzpW8ah3GbP`).

## What happens

- `package.json`: `"check:issue-citations": "node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --self-test"`. The script it wraps judges only its own fixtures. The diff-scoped board check is the bare `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs`, which CI runs right after it (`lint.yml` step 「Issue citations this change adds resolve on the board」).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, measured 2026-09-27 on `origin/main`, prints `pnpm check:issue-citations` on STDOUT as a plain command, with no marker.
- The same run's stderr flags same-shaped siblings, verbatim: 「pnpm check:closing-target-claim   ⚠ checker-health only (--self-test) — NOT a PR verdict」. `check:closing-target-claim` is also `node scripts/… --self-test` in `package.json`. The marker is applied inside the stderr artifact-roster section only (`dispatch-gates.mjs` about :8558), never to a stdout line.
- The real check does appear, on stderr, as 「⊘ NOT MEASURED — scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs」 under "take a VALUE FROM THE WORKFLOW". A dev running the stdout list, which the dispatch contract asks for, never sees that line next to the command it ran.

## The cost, measured this round (the fleet decision it changes)

Three `domain:cli` devs ran the stdout list and reported `pnpm check:issue-citations → 0` as a pass: #19704 (PR #20187), #20156 (PR #20190) and #19722 (PR #20195). Two of those PRs then went red in CI at exactly the board check:
- PR #20187 (job `108569681412`): 「[allocated-but-absent] packages/client/src/index.ts:2152 #12195」;
- PR #20190 (job `108570962968`): 「#10340」 at `rest-server.ts:4051` and 「#6241」 at `:7884`.

In each case a line the PR edited or moved carried a pre-existing citation the board no longer resolves. Each cost a CI cycle and a patch round. The local run the dispatch contract prescribes could not catch it, because the command the list names does not judge the diff.

## Direction (⛔ not a ruling)

Any stdout command whose `package.json` body is a `--self-test` of a script CI also runs diff-scoped should carry the same `⚠ checker-health only` marker on stdout. Better still, it should be followed on stdout by the runnable diff-scoped invocation, when one can run locally. The board check needs only a token, which a cloud container has. A pin: the stdout of `--commands` for a path that selects `check-issue-citations` names the self-test as checker-health only.

## Dedupe

MCP issue search in this repository, open and closed, run 2026-09-27: `dispatch-gates check:issue-citations self-test only not flagged checker-health stdout` → 0 hits.

Dedupe words: `dispatch-gates self-test stdout marker` · `check:issue-citations self-test only` · `checker-health only stdout`
